∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (e : Prod.{0, 0} Nat Nat),
  Iff
    (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.network g))
      e)
    (Or
      (∃ r,
        And (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.reps g) r)
          (Eq.{1} e (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 r) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 r) 1))))
      (Or
        (∃ j,
          And
            (LT.lt.{0} j
              (List.length.{0}
                (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))))
            (∃ a,
              And (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.argsOf g j) a)
                (Eq.{1} e
                  (Prod.mk.{0, 0}
                    (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.repOf g a)) 1)
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.repOf g j))))))
        (Or
          (∃ j,
            And
              (LT.lt.{0} j
                (List.length.{0}
                  (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.nodes (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g))))
              (And (Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.isSrcNode g j) Bool.true)
                (Eq.{1} e
                  (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.netS g)
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.repOf g j))))))
          (∃ j,
            And (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.outNodes g) j)
              (Eq.{1} e
                (Prod.mk.{0, 0}
                  (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.repOf g j)) 1)
                  (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.netT g)))))))

source.code:
/-- Shapes of the arcs. -/
theorem mem_arcs_iff (e : ℕ × ℕ) :
    e ∈ g.network.arcs ↔
      (∃ r ∈ g.reps, e = (2 * r, 2 * r + 1)) ∨
      (∃ j, j < g.base.nodes.length ∧ ∃ a ∈ g.argsOf j, e = (2 * g.repOf a + 1, 2 * g.repOf j)) ∨
      (∃ j, j < g.base.nodes.length ∧ g.isSrcNode j = true ∧ e = (g.netS, 2 * g.repOf j)) ∨
      (∃ j ∈ g.outNodes, e = (2 * g.repOf j + 1, g.netT)) := by
  show e ∈ g.nodeArcs ++ g.edgeArcs ++ g.srcArcs ++ g.snkArcs ↔ _
  simp only [List.mem_append, g.mem_nodeArcs, g.mem_edgeArcs, g.mem_srcArcs, g.mem_snkArcs,
    or_assoc]
